intro: A green, well-kept campus at Jyotinagar with the labs, library, fields and stages that a full school life needs, and the quiet order in which children flourish.

facilities.title: Science laboratories
facilities.text: Well-maintained Physics, Chemistry and Biology laboratories where students and teachers carry out the full range of practical work.

image.alt: Senior students in white lab coats conducting an experiment at a laboratory bench

facilities.title: Computer education
facilities.text: A dedicated computer lab where students learn with the help of trained professionals, from first clicks to Computer Science at ISC.

image.alt: Students seated at rows of computers in the school computer lab, facing a projected lesson

facilities.title: Library
facilities.text: A well-equipped library with a complete collection of the latest encyclopaedias. Students are encouraged to borrow widely, for free periods at school and for reading at home.
facilities.details: [[TO CONFIRM: number of books and a real photograph of the library]]

facilities.title: Games & athletics
facilities.text: Wide playing fields and coaching in basketball, football, kabaddi, kho-kho and athletics. Our teams have won gold at ASISC regional and national level.

image.alt: Young students sprinting across the green school field on sports day

facilities.title: Cultural activities
facilities.text: Year-round training in speech, essay writing, debate, skits, dance, music and drawing, and the open-air Divine Mercy Rangmanch stage to perform on.

image.alt: Students in colourful folk costumes performing a dance on the school stage

facilities.title: Campus & classrooms
facilities.text: A purpose-built campus opened in 2005, with landscaped gardens, airy classrooms and a large assembly ground.
facilities.details: [[TO CONFIRM: campus area, number of classrooms, which spaces are air-conditioned]]

image.alt: Front of the school building with its tall cross motifs, a statue and gardens under a blue sky

facilities.title: School transport
facilities.text: The school runs its own transport so that students travel to and from school safely.
facilities.details: [[TO CONFIRM: routes, areas covered and transport contact]]

facilities.title: Under surveillance
facilities.text: The campus is under surveillance, and only a parent or guardian whose photograph is registered in the school handbook may take a child home during school hours.

boarding.title: Boarding
text: Boarding offers children an opportunity to grow, in an environment that is the next best thing to being at home.
Boarders live within the rhythm of a convent school: regular study, prayer, play and the care of the sisters.

image.alt: Students in house sashes assembled in front of the school building with flags

safety.title: Supervised campus
safety.text: The campus is under surveillance, and visitors deal with the school office rather than meeting teachers or children in class.

safety.title: Registered pick-up
safety.text: During school hours a child leaves only in real necessity, with written permission, and only with a parent or guardian whose photograph is in the handbook.

safety.title: Safe conveyance
safety.text: School transport brings children to and from school safely.

safety.title: Order & discipline
safety.text: Clear discipline policies and safety measures keep the school calm and conducive to learning.

service.title: Sneha Sadan
service.text: The school runs Sneha Sadan, a home for girls from poor families, providing free boarding, lodging and education to uplift them.

service.title: Outreach
service.text: Management, staff and students reach out together to the less privileged, with medical assistance for the needy and help to build homes for the homeless.

service.title: Fee concession
service.text: Each year about ten percent of our students, those who are financially weak and eligible, receive a fee concession.

parents: Parent–teacher meetings run from 9:00 AM to 12:00 noon, when teachers are available to discuss progress, conduct and attendance. On other days, please contact teachers through the Principal.
Parents are joint educators: we ask you to help instil noble ideals, good discipline and polite behaviour.
Please mention your child’s class and division in any letter to the Principal.
Parents may not enter classrooms or speak to teachers during class hours.
Please raise any concern with the Principal rather than criticising teachers or the school in front of children.
No private tuition should be arranged without the Principal’s permission.
